import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix island label variant (extra whitespace)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Count penguins per island; drop any missing group keys
    counts = df['island'].value_counts()
    result = {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items() if pd.notna(k)}
    return result
